users.bio: Backend engineer. Distributed systems, strong coffee, weak opinions. #rustlang
Illustrator & type nerd. Drawing one tiny thing every day.
Trail runner, data analyst, sourdough apologist.

Product designer. Shipping small things often.
Previously: lots of whiteboards.
Librarian by day. 52 books a year, give or take. #books
Home cook. If it has cumin in it, I'm interested.
Balcony gardener. Currently negotiating with a tomato plant.
